title: eugenia neoformosa
intro: Eugenia neoformosa, commonly known as the Brazil cherry or camu camu, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. It is valued for its rich antioxidant and vitamin C content, providing numerous health benefits such as boosting the immune system, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia neoformosa include acting as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
